sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Deterministic validation fails because no sh:NodeShape or sh:PropertyShape with a recognizable substantive constraint is declared. Preserve this correct ship applicability target requiring both polarClass and urI1ComplianceStatus=true, but attach it via sh:target to the substantive UR I2 constraint shape(s); do not freeze it as a standalone target-only graph, turn either applicability input into an obligation, add tautological class/property constraints, or require the redundant urI2Applicability boolean.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate turns the applicability condition into obligations: any ship having polarClass is required to have both urI1ComplianceStatus=true and a stored urI2Applicability=true.
